message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: On March 4, 2016 night, defendant Li and accomplices planned theft. After midnight, Li drove vehicle to location guided by Xu, they entered houses by climbing windows (爬窗入室) i.e., illegal entry into residence, then stole cigarettes and an OPPO phone. Value 10749 yuan.

Thus crimes: illegal intrusion into residence (非法侵入住宅) and theft (盗窃). In examples, they sometimes label only one charge: e.g., first example: "非法侵入住宅" for breaking into house and stealing cash. That case: they entered via window, stole cash and phone. They labeled "非法侵入住宅". So they considered illegal intrusion as the charge, not theft. Possibly they treat theft as part of illegal intrusion? In that example, they used "非法侵入住宅". So for this case, similar: they entered via window and stole items. Likely charge: 非法侵入住宅. Could also include 盗窃. But training examples: For burglary-like theft, they used "非法侵入住宅". For other theft examples where entry not via intrusion, they used "盗窃". Example: "周1某在北京盗窃郝某现金及手机" they labeled "盗窃". That case didn't mention illegal entry. So if illegal entry is present, they choose "非法侵入住宅". So answer: [罪名]非法侵入住宅<eoa>.
